question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

QUEST : VUGWS :: REACH : JECGT :: SOLVE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (2) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series and is written diagonally.

So,

 
• QUEST : VUGWS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d02fd2756e3d099e8e100dee386141532769e0e784c41ef9b431e679f206a4df.png] 

And,

 
• REACH : JECGT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eced4359cf442ccf795dc719e4294b5ba738c24ee8636495be5936cd4dbca73b.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• SOLVE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ce4ffc30b1794c8667ee86d9c5eab7ef3d08f6ab3f84f85d18fb8f7ffad056c.png] 

​Hence, "**GXNQU**" is the correct answer.

1e
